description: VMP api-node — Deno Deploy via linked GitHub repository; Postgres via DATABASE_URL.
notes: Deno Deploy builds from the linked repo on every push (PR previews and production on main). Install/build/runtime are defined in deno.json (repo root and packages/api-node) using scripts/deno-deploy-install.mjs — do not use root npm ci; the monorepo lockfile includes optional native platform packages that fail npm ci on Linux. Prefer app directory packages/api-node in the Deno dashboard; root deno.json covers app-directory=repo-root. PR gate: npm run verify:api-node in ci.yml. Deploy gate: Deno Deploy build status on the PR.
